about: The published run: every number of docs/vs_llm.md. `bench.py score --check` recomputes them from raw/.

run.solvi: development snapshot of 0.7 (commit c8c4856); gallery task 11 as released in 0.6.1

models.jev-1.13: typesafe/jev-1.13 (served as typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917), a decision model over OpenRouter's System One / Decisions API, provider pinned to TypeSafe; run on 2026-09-29 with solvi 0.7.0 (commit f677406)
models.jeeves: PostHog/jeeves, self-hosted with its own server (github.com/PostHog/jeeves at f04ec55) on one Colab A100 40 GB in bf16, System One API with options {max_think: 768, nothink_threshold: 0.9}; run on 2026-09-29 with solvi at commit 191a417 (0.7.1 + Jeeves support); stability on half the subsample, inside solvi on the --budget subsets
models.jeeves-nothink: the same server with options {think: false}; every set in full
